items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: And whenever at church, whenever at state fairs or big conventions we'd be playing together

ctx.x: Any musicians that happen to be around. Let some musicians come on the scene and somehow we spot them out there and trot out our finest stuff. Used to be a W.E.O. Daniels had a band about the same time. And whenever at church, whenever at state fairs or big conventions we'd be playing together, we were always very careful to use only our best material when we saw them lurking in the sidelines.
